en.Introduction:Lore:
Surviving in Tarkov is no simple task for Amonya, a creature who was never meant to appear here. A mistake in a complex spell cast by her unicorn grandfather pulled her into this place. At first, she wanted only to return home, but instead of finding a way back, she learned how to hide. A black cloak conceals her unnaturally white mane, and she found joy in gathering all kinds of ammunition and even creating a new types. In time, she even found a trusted partner: you.

Now, after all the experience she has gained, Amonya has chosen to stay. She intends to take revenge on those who crossed her path and made her struggle in this land. This quiet pony values her beloved piles of ammunition, yet her hatred for her enemies runs even deeper. Eliminate them, bring her items useful to her life, and she will reward you with her ammo reserves. Amonya may even share experimental variants of ammunition that could aid you in your escape from Tarkov.
en.545x39Q1:Lore:
The day was already slipping into evening, the last rays of the setting sun stretching long and thin across the world. The silence around the abandoned apartment block was shattered by a gunshot.
Then another.
And another, this time accompanied by the sharp crack of breaking glass.
"What do they want from me now, those… those…" Amonya faltered, unable to come up with an insult worthy of the figures chasing her.
She had only arrived in this place fairly recently, but she had already done everything in her power to stay alive. Sometimes, though, everything you have simply isn’t enough.
en.545x39Q2:Lore: Another bullet tore past her ear. "Eeeeeep!" The near miss threw her off balance for a moment, but she managed to keep her feet. She reached the entrance and nearly sighed with relief when she saw the doors standing wide open. Without hesitation, she darted inside, desperately searching for somewhere to hide.
en.545x39Q3:Lore:
Up the stairs she went, stopping at the second floor. There was no point going any higher. From here, at least, she could still jump from a window if things went badly.
She raced down the corridor, passing one door after another. Halfway along, she spotted one that had clearly been forced open. She grabbed the handle.
The door swung inward.
Amonya slipped through and pulled it shut behind her.
en.545x39Q4:Lore:
Now she needed something heavy enough to keep the door closed. A chair, perhaps. A dresser. Anything that would stop those lunatics from getting to her.
Those same lunatics who had called her a furball and promised to turn her into a rug.
She scanned the room.
And found herself staring straight down the black, cold steel barrel of a shotgun.
en.545x39Q5:Lore: For a moment, the world stopped. The blood seemed to freeze in her veins, plunging to temperatures worthy of the South Pole. Very slowly, Amonya raised her head. Two cold, round lenses stared back at her from behind a gas mask. The figure lifted one finger to its lips. "Shhh…"
en.545x39Q6:Lore: Amonya cautiously edged sideways. To her immense relief, the barrel remained where it was. "You’ve become something of a celebrity around here," came the muffled voice from behind the mask. "We’ve never seen anyone quite like you." "That’s no reason to turn me into a rug!" Amonya protested. "Shhh…" the stranger chided her. "They’re close." A few moments later, voices drifted in from the corridor. Then the door handle turned. The door began to open.
en.545x39Q7:Lore: "You’ve got nowhere left to run, furball. Just stop struggling and it’ll be over before you know it. Won’t hurt that much…" The attacker froze. His eyes widened to the size of tennis balls when he saw the masked figure waiting inside. BAM! The black shotgun roared, and the intruder was hurled backward. BAM! BAM! His two companions barely had time to react before they suffered the same fate. Silence returned. There were no more of them. The little mare was clutching her ears. The gunshots had been painfully loud. Once she finally realized that it was over, she slowly turned toward the stranger who had just saved her. "Thank you, but… I don’t understand. Why…?"
en.545x39Q8:Lore: "Let’s just say I’m a fan." The voice came from beneath the mask. "You shouldn’t be here. But from the looks of it, you didn’t exactly choose to come here in the first place." The figure paused. "You seem like a nice person." A beat. "Pony," he corrected himself. "And I don’t like seeing nice people get hurt." He lowered the shotgun. "But you won’t last long if you keep doing things this way. So I’m going to show you the ropes." He glanced toward the door. "Now, let’s get moving before more scum come crawling out of the woodwork." And so, the two of them left.
